description: HQ100 - Verschneidungsergebnis Wasserspiegellage mit DHM bei einem HQ100 Ereignis für die Kläranlage bei Bliesdalheim is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Water level position with DHM at a HQ100 event for the sewage treatment plant near Bliesdalheim (map sheet 27), which is protected for this event and is therefore shown differently in the map; the data set shows all areas that are lower than the water level (technical flood protection from km 28.2 to 28.4) ... Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "HQ100 — Intersection result water level position with DHM at a HQ100 event for the sewage treatment plant near Bliesdalh" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Saarland, Geowissenschaften. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
